bestBets.overview: We're off to Albury for this Tuesday card and conditions were rated Heavy 10 early on Sunday morning. Plenty of room for improvement given the fine forecast, maybe we'll even get an upgrade to Soft. That's the hopeful side of me coming out. Tuesday began with a rating of Heavy 8. We open with a 1400m Class 1 and we are back to just five here. UNDERCUT comes out after racing at Narrandera over the weekend and CAPTAIN BARBOSSA was off to Wodonga on Monday. 3 and 5 to head up front and they make an appealing quinella. SIYAASI rises from a Maiden win but it was quite an emphatic performance, admittedly in a race that was made for him. This is harder for sure but he will be the one the others have to run past.

bestBets.overview: 5 and 2 look speediest over the short course and they both should kick on strongly in the last. BRIAL ROSE has hit her straps this prep and now won two of her latest three, including here for Ella Bent back in June. She's clearly a 1000m specialist and should just bounce out and go running here. RISKY WHISKY has won in southern Victoria and southern NSW his latest two and they have been clear-cut margins.
